pagerbot: :rotating_light: PD page fired: embeddings-service-us-west - 5xx spike detected (alert_id=pg-7892). auto-suppression_count=3, dedupe_key=embq-usw-1

Eli oncall: claiming — on it. jumping onto call in 2m. any customer-facing impact yet?

Ivy: seeing 5xx rate ~8% for last 90s, tail latency also bumped. traffic pattern shows a sudden increase in prefix hits to kv-cache — could be a malformed prefix regen. logs: `error=CacheWriteTimeout` across four workers.

Ravi: confirming — autoscaler didn't spin up new pods, HPA events show `target unavailable` for replicas 3->5. likely k8s imagepull or node pressure.

Eli oncall: thanks. Sam — can you check node saturation + evictions now? I’ll also trigger a scoped canary fallback to the lower-capacity embed-model-v1b.

Sam: looking. nodes 8/10 at ~92% mem on us-west-gpu-pool. two pods OOMKilled in the last 30s. kube events: `FailedScheduling` on 2 pods due to InsufficientGPU. attaching snippet:

```
# kube events
0m30s Pod embed-worker-23 OOMKilled container embed-runtime
0m28s Pod embed-worker-47 FailedScheduling InsufficientGPU
```

Sam: also seeing eviction churn from a daemonset pre-emption (gpuhanlder). escalating to infra for fast node drain check.

Eli oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable autoscaler override to allow burst to 10 replicas, 2) flip traffic to fallback embed-model-v1b (lower mem), 3) mark this incident as "suppression-handshake" to avoid duplicate automated pages while we stabilize.

pagerbot: acknowledgement: pagerbot initiated suppression handshake (suppression_id=sup-20240217-01). auto-backoff window set to 180s. subsequent duplicate pages will be suppressed and routed to pinned owner (Eli oncall).

Ravi: I can flip traffic to v1b now. deploying route override: `rdw route update embeddings --model embed-model-v1b --region us-west --weight 100`

deploy-bot: deploy started by Ravi. build=gh-embed/54b2 -> rollout id=roll-9832. streaming logs available at https://ci.internal/roll-9832

Nora (CS): heads-up: CS has one active support ticket from a key customer reporting "embeds 500". I’ll prepare the customer note: short outage + mitigation steps and ETA ~15m.

Ivy: after switching route, 5xx rate dropped to 1.2% within 40s. tail latency normalizing. currently KV cache thrash reduced.

Eli oncall: good. keeping suppression live until we confirm steady state for 10m. Sam — follow up with infra to add capacity or throttle non-critical batch jobs. Ravi — please keep rollback path ready.

Sam: infra confirmed ephemeral nodes are being provisioned; watching OOM trends. created ticket INFRA-3219 for node pool autoscaling rule tweak.

Ravi: rollout complete, traffic now 100% -> embed-model-v1b. rollback id ready: roll-9832-rollback if needed.

pagerbot: manual ack recorded by Eli oncall at 1748765488. suppression handshake active until 1748765668. any further alerts will escalate to Eli.

Eli oncall: status ping — mitigation applied, customer notified, monitoring shows stable. marking incident state: mitigated (post-mitigation checks ongoing). I’ll hand off to next oncall in 20m for follow-up and RCA.

Nora (CS): sent customer update: "We observed elevated 500s for embeddings in us-west; traffic routed to fallback model and mitigation in progress. Next update in 30 minutes or sooner."

Ivy: leaving logs + snippets in incident doc: https://redwood-internal/incidents/1748765432 (runbook ref: runbooks/embeddings-500s).

Eli oncall: thanks everyone. final check at +20m then handoff. :white_check_mark:
